title: Food Safety Checklist
subtitle: Food Safety Control: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Food Safety Checklist covers food lot, process step, sanitation control, monitoring point, and corrective action. The food-safety record owner records Food Safety Control criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Food Safety Checklist keeps Food Safety Control exceptions visible until the food-safety record owner handoff.
use_case: Use Food Safety Checklist at receiving, storage, preparation, processing, packing, and service area. Document food lot, process step, sanitation control, monitoring point, and corrective action identity before Food Safety Control begins. Compare food lot, process step, sanitation control, monitoring point, and corrective action findings with stated Food Safety Control criteria; route unresolved Food Safety Control issues to qualified food-safety reviewer. For Food Safety Checklist, confirm requirements for Food Safety Control. Ask qualified food-safety reviewer to review Food Safety Control conditions beyond the food-safety record owner's role.

sections.title: Inspector, location, and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Food Safety Control, identify responsible parties, receiving, storage, preparation, processing, packing, and service area, and the linked food lot, process step, sanitation control, monitoring point, and corrective action source.

fields.label: Control point, limit, method, and monitoring device

sections.title: Checklist findings and inspection checks
sections.guidance: Capture Food Safety Control facts for food lot, process step, sanitation control, monitoring point, and corrective action; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Food Safety Control inspection checks
items: Pest, waste, water, and facility condition

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: Use observed Food Safety Control evidence to state disposition. Keep limits visible and give Food-Safety Record Owner both correction and repeat-check responsibility.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Hold, correction, verification, and release decision
blocks.guidance: Pause Food Safety Control when product control, traceability, contamination, corrective action, or qualified disposition remains unresolved. Retain the available Food Safety Control proof and route unresolved food lot, process step, sanitation control, monitoring point, and corrective action scope to food-safety record owner.
